speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. I see you have a psychiatric history and a new onset movement disorder; can you describe exactly how your movements have changed and when it started? REQUEST TEST: Serum Copper and Ceruloplasmin. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain.

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Inability to remain still, persistent feeling of restlessness. I also have Frequent fidgeting, Repetitive crossing and uncrossing of legs, Pacing. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Restless Legs Syndrome (RLS) secondary to Copper Deficiency.
